security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: Spawn builds Roblox games from what you describe. It installs its own Roblox Studio plugin, reads the place you have open, and applies each build as one undo step. For creators 13 and up; a Spawn membership is required.
